title: The share rule on the true LCFs (arm A1), on validation links
description: The cost of estimation for the share rule (u = u0 + k busy max(0, 1 - receive/capacity), experiments/share_rule_export.py): the same rule read from the guest's live truth instead of net1 v4 (--oracle; each belief becomes the true value's bin centre in net1 v4's bins), for u0 in {0.125, 0.375} and k in {0, 0.5, 1, 2} (u0 = 0.375, k = 0 is the true-BDP rule chosen on validation in exp-rule-net1v4-val-11), next to the fixed rule (u = 0.125) and the share rule at k = 0.5, 1 and 2 on net1 v4, and BBRv3, on the five validation families (seed 11) and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s (experiments/copies.py, seed 11). Each oracle copy reads its own flow's truth. Reported: log utility against BBRv3 per family, and the copies' fairness, utilization and queueing delay.
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 0.5 1 2; for u0 in 0.125 0.375; do uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/oracle" "$G" --u0 $u0 --k 0 0.5 1 2 --oracle; done; P=(--policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx"); for k in 0.5 1 2; do P+=(--policy "share-k$k=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k$k.onnx"); done; for u0 in 0.125 0.375; do for k in 0 0.5 1 2; do P+=(--policy "oracle-u$u0-k$k=$OUT/oracle/share-u$u0-k$k-oracle.onnx"); done; done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && uv run python experiments/copies_report.py "$OUT"
